contexts.text: It is known that there are secretions and excretions, in series, from the kidneys down to the bladder... They who in the Grand Man constitute these provinces...
Elsewhere in the body, too, there are Secretories and Excretories; in the brain.

To the unclean excretions there also correspond other Spirits, namely, such as in the world have been tenacious of revenge... To the unclean excretions also correspond those who draw spiritual things down to unclean earthly ones...
(Thus) the thought is the Purificatory and Excretory of the evils seated in a man from his parents.

The brain has its Excretories, and so have all the viscera. Some of the things which are secreted serve for uses; as the salivas and the biles; some are cast out as excrementitious things through the pores of the skin, and other emunctories, as the nostrils. There were certain Spirits who belonged to the excrementitious things of the brain...
In the human body even the excretions perform a use; as the three biles...
